title: Mu Chen defeats Liu Yang
summary: Hong Ling looks after the beaten Tan Qingshan while Liu Yang taunts Mu Chen, sure that his middle-phase Spiritual Movement beats Mu Chen's initial phase. Liu Mubai and Hong Ling watch from the stands. Mu Chen reads Liu Yang's attacks, and when Liu Yang uses the Liu family's Flame Palm he turns to the Great Buddha Art and breaks through to the middle phase of Spiritual Movement mid-fight, then wins. Liu Yang tries to use the Spirit Destruction Bead; Mu Chen snatches it, Liu Mubai asks for it back, and Master Mo exposes it. Master Mo and Master Xi debate stripping Liu Yang of his promotion, but Mu Chen keeps the bead as Liu Yang's apology and lets the matter drop. Mu Chen, Tan Qingshan, Liu Yang and the other Spiritual Movement students of the Earth class are promoted to the Heaven class. Liu Ming reports that Blood Slaughter is hiding in the North Spiritual Plain.

cultivation: Mu Chen breaks through from the initial to the middle phase of Spiritual Movement during the Liu Yang fight. Liu Yang is at the middle phase of Spiritual Movement.
